text: Hara hiɓe ooloo(luuka ton nodda faaboo, ɓe wi'a: Joomi amen, yaltini men e Yiite ngen, men golla moƴƴere, seedunde e ko men huuwaynoo kon aduna, fii no men heɓira welayee Maa, men daɗa lepte Maa. Alla jaaboo ɓe: E Men wuurniraano on nguurndam, ɗam faalanooɗo waajitaade waajitoraynoo, o tuubana Alla, o golla ko moƴƴi? Nulaaɗo jertinoowo on e lepte Alla ɗen kadi ari e mon? Nganto alanaa on ɓaawo ɗum. Awa meeɗee kisan, sabu ballo alanaa tooñirɓe ko'e-mun ɓen geddi e keeferaaku.
